---
title: "A page-wide table cell with tbl-column: body"
filters:
  - wrapped
tbl-column: body
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

Quarto 1.10.19 still sets the table of a cell with `column: page`
page-wide when the document sets `tbl-column: body`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-body-page
#| tbl-cap: "A table from a cell with column: page."
#| column: page
#| classes: wrap-right
knitr::kable(head(cars, 2))
```

The paragraph after the page-wide table.
